cl.subject: Application for Project Support Officer
body: I bring hands-on project coordination and clear status reporting to your Project Support Officer role. For a volunteer event, I kept the task list current and collected progress updates from six volunteers.
My weekly summaries gave the organizer a clear view of unresolved tasks. This experience translates directly to keeping your project team informed and its next steps visible.
I would welcome a conversation about contributing this practical coordination experience to your community programmes.
